items.title: Harry "Chicken" Oscar Interview, 1959-07-11
items.q: Little William Brown played bass. ... Lewis Nelson and myself on trombone.

ctx.x: They had little Eddie Johnson on sax. They had Sidney Cades on banjo. Montague on drums. Sae Frazier on drums. Oily Strapani played bass drum. Old man Joe Howard played bass. Little William Brown played bass. They had Sonny Henry. Harrison Barnes over the river. Lewis Nelson and myself on trombone. They had George McCollum. Line up for a bass. Lewis DeMaine. Gilbert Young. And Bob used to play down at Valentis on trumpet. He played bass down there, Steve Valentis.
